messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 04:00–07:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday between 04:00 and 07:00 BST for a scheduled storage upgrade. Please check in any open documents before Friday close of business. Email and calendar are unaffected.

If you have any urgent access needs during the window, raise a ticket via the portal.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
